units.source_text: 夫人果然不在家，女佣也和夫人一起出去了，所以留在家里的只有K和小姐。

en.t: Madam was indeed not at home, and the maid had gone out with her, so only K and the young lady were left in the house.

units.source_text: 我有些不解，因为我在这里已经住了很长时间，

en.t: I was somewhat puzzled, because I had already been living there for a long time,

units.source_text: 夫人还从来没有只把小姐和我单独留在家里自己出门过。

en.t: and Madam had never gone out leaving only the young lady and me alone in the house.

units.source_text: 于是我问小姐：‘夫人有什么要紧事吗？’

en.t: So I asked the young lady, "Did Madam have something urgent to do?"

units.source_text: 我讨厌女人这种时候发笑。

en.t: I disliked it when women laughed at such moments.

units.source_text: 也许可以说这是年轻女子的共同点，小姐也是个动不动就爱笑的女子。

en.t: Perhaps one could say it was a trait common to young women; the young lady too was the sort who was quick to laugh at the slightest thing.

units.source_text: 不过，小姐看到我脸色不悦，便马上恢复了平时的神情，认真地答道，妈妈有点事出去了，不是什么急事。

en.t: However, when the young lady saw the displeasure on my face, she immediately returned to her usual expression and answered seriously that her mother had gone out on a small errand, and that it was nothing urgent.

units.source_text: 我是个房客，无权再追问下去，便不作声了。

en.t: As a lodger, I had no right to press the matter further, so I fell silent.

units.source_text: 我换了衣服，刚要坐下，夫人和女佣回来了。

en.t: I changed my clothes and was just about to sit down when Madam and the maid returned.

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，就到了大家围着饭桌吃晚饭的时间。

en.t: Before long, it was time for everyone to gather around the dining table for supper.

units.source_text: 刚住进来那会儿，一切都按客人对待，所以晚饭一般都是由女佣送到我房间里来的。

en.t: When I first moved in, I was treated in every respect as a guest, so supper was usually brought to my room by the maid.

units.source_text: 可是这个规矩不知什么时候改变了，吃饭时，我被请到她们那里去吃了。

en.t: But at some point this custom changed, and at mealtimes I was invited to eat with them.

units.source_text: K刚搬来的时候，我也要求她们要像对我一样对待他。

en.t: When K first moved in, I also asked them to treat him the same way they treated me.

units.source_text: 为此我还送给夫人一张薄板做的、可以折叠的漂亮饭桌。

en.t: For that purpose, I even gave Madam a fine dining table made of thin boards that could be folded up.

units.source_text: 现在一般家庭都用这种桌子了，可那个时候，几乎没有几家围着这样的桌子吃饭的。

en.t: Nowadays ordinary households all use this kind of table, but at that time there were hardly any families who sat around such a table to eat.

units.source_text: 我是特意去茶之水的家具店，让店家按照我设计的样子做出来的。

en.t: I had gone specially to a furniture shop in Ochanomizu and had the shop make it according to my own design.
